clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-app-.name: clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-app-rules/app-outcome-denied?
clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-app-.rhs-form:
(do
 (let
  [all-checks
   [{:check-type :document, :status ?doc-check-status}
    {:check-type :identity, :status ?identity-check-status}
    {:check-type :fraud, :status ?fraud-check-status}]
   passed-checks
   (into
    []
    (comp (filter (comp #{:pass} :status)) (map :check-type))
    all-checks)
   failed-checks
   (into
    []
    (comp (remove (comp #{:pass} :status)) (map :check-type))
    all-checks)]
  (r/insert!
   (map->ApplicationOutcome
    {:app-id ?app-id,
     :status :denied,
     :message "Application denied",
     :passed-checks passed-checks,
     :failed-checks failed-checks}))))

clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-app-.name: clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-app-rules/app-outcome-pending?
clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-app-.rhs-form:
(do
 (let
  [all-checks
   [{:check-type :document, :complete? (boolean (seq ?doc-checks))}
    {:check-type :identity, :complete? (boolean (seq ?id-checks))}
    {:check-type :fraud, :complete? (boolean (seq ?fraud-checks))}]
   checks-complete
   (into [] (comp (filter :complete?) (map :check-type)) all-checks)
   checks-incomplete
   (into [] (comp (remove :complete?) (map :check-type)) all-checks)]
  (r/insert!
   (map->ApplicationOutcome
    {:app-id ?app-id,
     :status :pending,
     :message "Application pending",
     :checks-complete checks-complete,
     :checks-incomplete checks-incomplete}))))

clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.lhs-form:
[clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan_app_facts.Application
 (= ?app-id app-id)]
[:loan-doc-rules/document-check-input
 [{:keys [app-id required-docs given-docs missing-required-docs]}]
 (= ?app-id app-id)
 (= ?required-docs required-docs)
 (= ?given-docs given-docs)
 (= ?missing-required-docs missing-required-docs)]
clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.name: clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-rules/app-has-all-required-docs
clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.rhs-form:
(do
 (let
  [status
   (if (seq ?missing-required-docs) :fail :pass)
   message
   (case
    status
    :fail
    "Missing required documents"
    "All required documents found")]
  (r/insert!
   (laf/map->DocumentCheck
    {:app-id ?app-id, :status status, :message message}))))

clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.doc:
After document checks pass, write an audit trail entry via opaque builder.
   The analyzer detects an insert but cannot resolve the fact type — the
   builder is a custom non-record function. This stays unresolved.
clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.name: clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-rules/dynamic-insert-audit-trail

clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.doc:
After document checks pass, trigger a compliance review via Java constructor.
   The analyzer sees the ComplianceReview. call but cannot statically determine
   its return type — captured as a dynamic insert callsite.
clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.name: clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-rules/dynamic-insert-compliance-review

clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.doc:
Same compliance review, but built via metadata-map style.
   The analyzer captures the with-meta form as a dynamic callsite.

clara.server.tools.graph.rules.loan-doc-.doc:
When doc check passes, retract any stale-document notice via Java constructor.
